assumptions.choice: Range = highest High (not Close) over the lookback window
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'highest price over the last 20 sessions'; High is the literal reading of 'price' for a breakout/range level.

assumptions.choice: Both the 20-session range and the 20-session average volume are computed over the PRIOR 20 sessions, excluding the current signal day (via data(-1) shift)
assumptions.reason: Core idea explicitly frames this as a breakout 'from the previous price range,' and comparing the day's Open to a range that already includes that same day's not-yet-known High would be internally inconsistent; the same treatment is applied to the volume SMA so today's own spike doesn't inflate its own baseline.

assumptions.choice: Use the daily bar's full-day Volume field as 'current trading volume' for the open-based entry check
assumptions.reason: Only end-of-day OHLCV bars are available; true volume-at-market-open is not present in the feed, so the closest literal reading uses the bar's total daily volume.

assumptions.choice: Entry signal is computed from the current bar's Open in next() and submitted via self.buy(); actual same-bar-open vs next-bar-open fill timing depends on the harness-owned cerebro/broker configuration
assumptions.reason: Guaranteeing execution at the same day's open requires cheat-on-open broker settings, which are part of the fixed cerebro setup added by the harness, outside the strategy class's control.

assumptions.choice: Exit implemented as a good-until-filled limit sell order at $28.00, submitted immediately once the entry buy completes
assumptions.reason: This is the direct backtrader mechanism for 'close the position when price reaches $28'; it naturally stays pending across days, matching 'if the target level is not reached, the position must remain open.'

assumptions.choice: size = int(available cash / entry-day open price) — all-in whole-share sizing at signal time
assumptions.reason: Spec calls for 'fixed position size (100% of the portfolio per trade)', so this is the standard all-in equity sizing formula rather than the unstated-sizing default.
